 I'm a Celeb's Wayne Rooney admits he "would’ve been dead" without wife Coleen's support 
 The ex-footballer opened up about his drinking habits.
 By Kirsty McCormack Published: 17 November 2026 %0A%09<path d="M240,128a15.74,15.74,0,0,1-7.6,13.51L88.32,229.65a16,16,0,0,1-16.2.3A15.86,15.86,0,0,1,64,216.13V39.87a15.86,15.86,0,0,1,8.12-13.82,16,16,0,0,1,16.2.3L232.4,114.49A15.74,15.74,0,0,1,240,128Z">%0A</path></svg>" width="60" height="60" alt="Play video"/> Wayne Rooney has opened up to his fellow campmates about his marriage to his wife Coleen, admitting that she is his "absolute rock".
 The ex-footballer wasted no time in having heartfelt conversations with his I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! co-stars, and Tuesday's episode ( 17 November ) saw him address his past drinking habits.
 During a chat with some of his fellow campmates, Wayne - who has already been branded a "winner" by some I'm a Celeb viewers - was quizzed on his football career, which saw him play for England, as well as Everton and Manchester United.
 Speaking about finding fame at a young age, he explained: "It is hard when you’re a young player, and you’re earning a lot of money to stay in the zone and try and get away from all that... [it's] so difficult."
 ITV Journalist Mariella Frostrup then asked him: "How did you?" He responded: "I struggled; I turned to alcohol when I was in my early twenties. I didn’t wanna be around people, so I’d drink in the house for a couple of days… I struggled with the pressure of it."
 Referring to his eldest son, Kai, who is now 17, Wayne continued: "To be honest, I’d be lying on a pool table in my house, and I remember Kai walked in and found me asleep. And then it was a wake-up call; it was like, what are you doing?"
 What to Read Next
 When campmate Ade Adepitan asked him how much he was drinking at his worst, Wayne didn't shy away from being honest, and recalled "drinking non-stop for two days".
 "Then I’d get up, go and train for the rest of the week and then I’d score two goals on the Saturday, so you think it's OK," he went on. 
 BBC Wayne was then quizzed on his biggest regret, but he couldn't pick just one single moment.
 "Loads, if I’m being honest - in terms of both mistakes made off the pitch and regrets when you drink alcohol. Then you’re missing out on time with your kids and stuff."
 He shared: "That’s why now, the last six months, I haven’t drank. I think me clean, me with the kids, is probably the happiest place I’ve ever been. It’s only now that I’m seeing it, but I’m grateful that my family hasn’t fallen apart."
 Former Coronation Street star Claire Sweeney was keen to mention his wife of 18 years, Coleen: "She’s been good, hasn’t she? Standing by you through thick and thin." 
 Wayne replied: "She’s been amazing; I probably would’ve been dead, if I’m honest, if it weren’t for her. She’s my absolute rock, still is." He then added: "I never thought I'd be in the place I am now, physically and mentally."
 Coleen made her own appearance on I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! back in 2024. She made it to the final, but lost out on the crown to McFly singer Danny Jones. Before entering the jungle this week, Wayne revealed the advice his wife gave him on how to navigate the camp and trials on the show . 
 I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! airs on ITV1. 
 Alcohol Change UK offers information, advice and support with their questions about drinking and the problems that can sometimes be caused by alcohol. For more information, visit Alcohol Change UK's website . 
 Drinkline also offers free, confidential advice to anyone who is concerned about their own or someone else's drinking on 0300 123 1110 (weekdays 9am–8pm, weekends 11am–4pm). 
 Readers can also contact Drinkaware .
